cases.text: Spaced repetition shows a card again just before you would forget it.

A deck of cards grows as the notes grow. Each card keeps the date it is due, how stable the memory of it is and how hard it was the last time. Review takes the cards that are due, oldest first, and shows the front; the answer decides when the card comes back. Карточка, которую вспомнили легко, вернётся позже, а забытая вернётся завтра.
